facts.text: I started a consistent cleaning habit about 3 weeks ago.
I tidy up my living room for 10-15 minutes every morning after breakfast.
I do a load of laundry every Sunday evening.
I vacuum or sweep the floors at least every other day.
Last week I skipped my morning tidying routine for two days.
Skipping my morning tidying routine for two days made my living room feel more cluttered.
I like anchoring my tidying routine to a habit like brushing my teeth.
I want to make tidying a mindful activity to enjoy the process more.
I struggle with cleaning my room because clutter builds up there.
It has been weeks since I did a deep clean of my room.
I have a specific goal to clean my room this weekend.
I have accumulated a lot of clothes that I don't wear anymore.
I am not sure whether to donate my unwanted clothes or try to sell them.
I am considering using Facebook Marketplace to sell my clothes.
I am considering using local consignment shops to sell my clothes.
I am considering using a hybrid approach to selling unwanted clothes.
I am considering hosting a yard sale or garage sale.
I plan to start by taking photos and listing a few items on Facebook Marketplace.
I want tips on how to write a good description for my Facebook Marketplace listings.
